incarnation: The Crownless Sea — Brann Crow selected individual V2 portrait, original project canon (2026)

references.provenance: Selected HEROES_DB portrait equals production.audiovisual.portrait; exact local Git LFS original object restored by root.

silhouette: Broad heavily built human nautical carpenter/protector, deep chest, thick forearms, stocky strong legs; not the slim clean-shaven older navy-coat atlas.
anatomy: Two human arms/two legs, five fingers when readable; source apparent adult proportions without inventing a chronological age.
face: Warm medium-dark brown skin, broad nose, heavy black eyebrows, full dense black beard and moustache, stern weathered face. Exact iris/tiny skin details not specified.
costume: Long distressed near-black/dark-brown leather coat with gold piping and ragged mustard-gold lining, rolled sleeves; loose ivory V-neck shirt, crossed brown chest harness, broad double leather waist belt and hanging dark pouch on anatomical LEFT hip; dark brown trousers and black/brown lace-up calf boots.
palette: Near-black/dark brown, warm leather, ivory, weathered brass/gold and mustard lining; no navy coat or bright scarlet sash from old atlas.
distinguishingMarks: Black hair with shaved sides and short braided/dreadlocked top trailing behind, full beard; small silver necklace at ivory collar. No pirate hat or eyepatch.
equipment: Long boarding axe carried in anatomical LEFT hand in the source, single broad downcurving steel bearded blade with weathered gold damage/patina, rear angular projection, dark wood shaft with rope/brass wraps and blunt butt. RIGHT hand may show source cyan broken-chain sea magic only in Nexus CG05.
forbiddenMixes: Old slim navy clean-shaven sprite is historical comparison only, not current identity. No borrowed franchise pirate face, bandana, tricorn, pistol or cutlass; weapons not established by portrait remain absent.

scopeLimitations: Original project character: current selected individual V2 portrait is internal visual authority, not an independent external franchise source.
Unseen back of coat/axe and exact eye details not fully specified; no automatic perfect1:1 certification.
The source includes other people; they do not qualify Brann identity and are not copied into new solo compositions.
New locations are original age-of-sail Crownless Sea environments coherent with free crews, imperial route control and sea magic; not official screenshots.
CG05 is Nexus adaptation; CG09-11 Fan Art; CG12-15 What If; alternate costume/effects in specials do not redefine Canon identity.
The previous selected atlas is a slim clean-shaven navy-clothed design with no axe; preserved as variant rather than reused as identity.

incarnationDecision.reason: V2 robust bearded carpenter with brown/gold coat and boarding axe; former slender clean-shaven navy sprite contradicts current portrait.
